cash.title: How much cash would you need to buy?
cash.intro: Write down the money you have, the costs you know about and the estimates you still need.

steps.title: How much cash would you want to use?
steps.prompt: Start with what you have available and what you want to keep in savings.

fields.label: Cash available for buying — amount or not sure
Savings I want to keep — amount or not sure

steps.title: What have you been quoted?
steps.prompt: Use estimates you have been given. Leave unknown amounts blank or write “need quote.”

fields.label: Down payment — amount or not sure
Closing costs — amount or not sure

steps.title: What else would you need cash for?
steps.prompt: Add purchase or moving costs that are not already included above. If you are unsure whether something is included, ask.

steps.title: Has anyone discussed help with the costs?
steps.prompt: Record what you have been told and what you still need to confirm.

options.label: I have written details to review

fields.label: What I still need to ask about it

steps.title: What do you want Brooks to explain?
steps.prompt: Choose the missing amount or cost that would help you most.

cash.disclosure: Discussing a credit or assistance does not mean it is approved.

credit.title: What do you want to know about your credit?
credit.intro: Write down your question before making a change.

steps.title: What have you been told so far?
steps.prompt: If you have spoken with a lender, write down what you want to understand.

steps.title: What are you unsure about?
steps.prompt: Choose a topic or describe it in your own words.

options.label: A credit score I was shown

steps.title: Are you thinking about making a change?
steps.prompt: Write down anything you are considering so you can ask about it before acting.

steps.title: What would you like Brooks to answer first?
steps.prompt: Write the question you want answered before making a change.

credit.disclosure: This page collects questions. It does not recommend paying, disputing, opening or closing an account.

compare.title: How do these two loan estimates compare?
compare.intro: Put the written estimates side by side. Leave anything you cannot find blank and ask Brooks to explain it.

steps.title: Are these estimates for the same purchase?
steps.prompt: Differences in the property, price, down payment or loan term can change the numbers.

fields.label: Same property, price, down payment and loan term?
Differences or details I need to check

steps.title: What rates and fees are shown?
steps.prompt: Copy what each estimate says. Do not assume a lower rate means a lower total cost.

fields.label: Option A — rate and APR as shown
Option A — points or lender credits as shown
Option B — rate and APR as shown
Option B — points or lender credits as shown

steps.title: What would you pay each month?
steps.prompt: Check whether the two monthly amounts include the same costs.

fields.label: Option A — total monthly payment — amount or not sure
Option A — costs included or missing
Option B — total monthly payment — amount or not sure
Option B — costs included or missing

steps.title: How much cash would each option need?
steps.prompt: Copy the cash-to-close estimate. Note any fees you want explained.

fields.label: Option A — cash to close — amount or not sure
Option B — cash to close — amount or not sure
Fees or amounts I want explained

steps.title: Which difference do you want Brooks to explain?
steps.prompt: Choose the difference you most want explained.

compare.disclosure: This comparison does not choose a loan for you.

ready.title: What do you still need for preapproval?
ready.intro: Keep track of what you have been asked for and what you still need.

steps.title: What have you done so far?
steps.prompt: Write down any application or conversation you have already had.

options.label: I have spoken with a lender
I have been asked for documents

fields.label: What I have been asked for

steps.title: Which requested documents do you have?
steps.prompt: Mark the status of documents you have been asked for.

options.label: I do not have it yet
I do not have it yet

fields.label: Other requested items and whether I have them

steps.title: Has your income or job changed?
steps.prompt: Tell Brooks what needs updating.

steps.title: What do you need next?
steps.prompt: Pick the missing item or question you want help with first.

ready.disclosure: Document examples are not a list that everyone must provide. Follow the requests for your application.

offer.title: What happens after your offer is accepted?
offer.intro: Keep the dates and next steps you have been given in one place. If you are unsure, ask the person handling that part of the purchase.

steps.title: Where do things stand?
steps.prompt: Choose the stage that fits your situation.

options.label: I am getting ready to make an offer

steps.title: What dates have you been given?
steps.prompt: Use dates from your agent, lender or transaction documents. Leave them blank if you do not know.

fields.label: Inspection date or deadline I was given
Financing date or deadline I was given
Who gave me these dates / what I need to confirm

steps.title: What needs to happen next?
steps.prompt: Write the next task and who is handling it.

steps.title: What do you need explained?
steps.prompt: Write the question you most want answered.

fields.label: What I am worried about or unsure of

offer.disclosure: This page does not set deadlines or interpret contract terms. Confirm dates and contract questions with your agent, lender or an appropriate professional.

shop.title: Which home fits what you want to spend?
shop.intro: Compare two homes you are considering and the questions you would want answered before choosing.

steps.title: Which homes are you comparing?
steps.prompt: A nickname is enough. You do not need to enter an address.

steps.title: What matters to you about each home?
steps.prompt: Write your must-haves and anything that makes you hesitate.

fields.label: What I want in a home or area
Home A — what makes me hesitate
Home B — what makes me hesitate

steps.title: What would each home cost each month?
steps.prompt: Use estimates you have. Note which costs are already included so you do not count them twice.

fields.label: Home A — housing payment with taxes and insurance — amount or not sure
Home A — HOA, utilities and commute costs; included or separate?
Home B — housing payment with taxes and insurance — amount or not sure
Home B — HOA, utilities and commute costs; included or separate?

steps.title: What do you need to know about repairs?
steps.prompt: Write down condition or repair questions to ask the agent, inspector or other relevant professional.

steps.title: What would you want answered before choosing?
steps.prompt: Choose the question you most want answered before deciding.

shop.disclosure: This comparison records your notes; it does not score or rank homes.

plan.title: What needs to happen before you buy?
plan.intro: Start with when you would like to move, what you already know and one next step.

steps.title: When would you like to move?
steps.prompt: Write the timing that works for you and any lease date you need to check.

fields.label: When I would like to move
Lease date I need to plan around
What I need to check about my lease

steps.title: What have you already worked out?
steps.prompt: A short note is enough. You do not need to fill out your whole budget again.

fields.label: What I know about the payment I want
What I know about cash needed

steps.title: What still needs an answer?
steps.prompt: Write down the question that is keeping you from deciding what to do next.

steps.title: What is one thing you want to do next?
steps.prompt: Choose your next step and when you want to check back.

fields.label: When I want to check back

plan.disclosure: Dates on this page are your planning dates, not a promised purchase timeline.
